messages.author: Tony Ro
messages.title: Assistant Professor position - CUNY Graduate Center and Flatiron Institute
messages.body_html:
The Graduate Center of the City University of New York (CUNY) invites applications for a tenure-track Assistant Professor position in Cognitive Neuroscience. This position is part of a strategic initiative to expand interdisciplinary research and training in neuroscience and the computational sciences. We seek an innovative scholar whose research integrates computational approaches with empirical neuroscience to investigate the mechanisms underlying cognition. The ideal candidate will have a strong record of research in perception, planning, decision-making, memory, or animal communication and/or human language. The appointment will be in the M.S. Program in Cognitive Neuroscience. Responsibilities include research, teaching, mentoring, and service. The candidate is expected to generate an active, externally funded research program, and to participate in graduate teaching and research training. Teaching duties may include courses in computational methods and advanced courses in neuroscience. Candidates should demonstrate a commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration and to mentoring graduate students in a diverse and inclusive academic environment. This position is part of the Simons Empire Faculty Fellows initiative and applicants must also apply to the 3-year Visiting Scholar position in the Center for Computational Neuroscience (CCN) posted on the Flatiron Institute’s website. The incumbent will split their time between teaching (50%) at the Graduate Center and conducting research at CCN (50%). Applications to both positions are required, and it is acceptable to submit identical applications to both. However, applicants are welcome to comment on specific synergies with CCN in their cover letter for the Flatiron application.

 

For further details and to apply (the start date has been extended to January 2027):

https://cuny.jobs/new-york-ny/assistant-professor-ms-in-cognitive-neuroscience/51674D0A749E42818AB89D06270999B5/job/

 

https://apply.interfolio.com/179677

 

Best, 

Tony

 

Tony Ro, Ph.D.

Presidential Professor, Programs in Psychology and Biology

Director, Program in Cognitive Neuroscience

topics.snippet: The Wu Tsai Institute Postdoctoral Fellowships are open to applications! We welcome early-career

messages.author: Giovanna Guerrero-Medina
messages.title: Wu Tsai Institute Postdoctoral Fellowships (Oct 1st) Interdisciplinary and computational neuroscience and cognition
messages.body_html:
The Wu Tsai Institute Postdoctoral Fellowships are open to applications! We welcome early-career scientists interested in interdisciplinary research to advance fundamental understanding of cognition. 

 

The program offers a generous salary ($80K) for up to 3 years, discretionary funds and funding opportunities, access to cutting-edge facilities, protected time for professional development, structured mentoring, and a welcoming and inclusive community of trainees. International applicants are welcome.

 

Applicants may propose to be co-mentored by Wu Tsai Faculty Members from different disciplines; work with a single mentor while transitioning to a new field; or propose self-directed computational or theoretical projects with flexible mentoring arrangements. 

 

The deadline for applications is October 1st. Candidates can find more information and application instructions here: https://wti.yale.edu/initiatives/postdoctoral 

 

Giovanna Guerrero-Medina, PhD 

She/Her/Ella

Asst. Director for Professional Development & Community

Wu Tsai Institute

Yale University
